intent: Admit one idempotent SADHANA Mission Control bootstrap over the existing TaskBoard and RuntimeStateStore owners. The one-shot CLI pins the exact external goal-contract bytes, validates its schema, campaign identity, ten-goal DAG, and all existing mission/task state before effects, resumes only an exact dependency-closed partial initialization, and returns one byte-stable goal-to-task map with a separately typed G05 canary identifier.

interface_mismatches: The external contract owns goal intent while MissionControl owns mission/task projections; bootstrap must bind them by an exact byte digest without copying the contract file into Git or creating another truth store.
TaskBoard allocates opaque task IDs, so stable MissionControl idempotency keys establish identity and the initializer emits the canonical goal-to-task mapping in deterministic dependency order.

Mission and task owners use separate databases and cannot be atomically initialized together; only dependency-closed exact partial state is resumable, while any conflicting or non-closed partial state must fail before another write.

The supervisor owns the reserved mission_campaign runtime session and its writer/control fences; this bootstrap may create only the MissionControl mission and TaskBoard tasks and must remain a separate one-shot ExecStartPre command.
honest_blockers: This admission changes no runtime code, reads no external contract, creates no mission or task, starts no supervisor, performs no dispatch, and proves no process, transport, model, or acceptance liveness.
An exact goal-contract digest proves byte identity only; it does not prove that a goal is true, beneficial, complete, authorized for external effects, or independently accepted.

The implementation can fence concurrent bootstrap invocations but cannot make separate TaskBoard and RuntimeStateStore databases one atomic transaction or exclude an unrelated direct writer outside the controlled service startup order.
Task existence and the selected G05 canary identifier are configuration facts only; canary success requires separately recorded independent acceptance.
No host deployment unit or production state change is admitted by this packet.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the admission commit and its generated track mirrors. No mission, task, campaign session, claim, lease, supervisor, transport, model, acceptance, deployment, or external state is changed by admission rollback.
